charts.title: Kepler-37 c: orbits around Kepler-37
charts.description: The orbits of Kepler-37's planets in this map from above, to scale, with Kepler-37 c highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Holczer et al. 2016 (2016ApJS..225....9H), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname HOLCZER_ET_AL__2016): P 21.30191004 d
